name: Utah DEQ Environmental Incidents (DERR spill hotline reports) ArcGIS feature service
operator: Utah Department of Environmental Quality, Division of Environmental Response and Remediation
waters_covered: statewide; incidents reported to the DEQ spill hotline and after-hours duty officers
access_detail: Public ArcGIS Online feature service (owner DEQ_UGRCdevelopers), 8,974 rows on 2026-11-03, maxRecordCount 2000, exports csv/geojson. Query e.g. where=Incident_summary like '%sewage%' or Title_EventName like '%sew%' (270 rows). Each row links a PDF 'Spills Report' (ReportLink on deqspillsps.deq.utah.gov). The older search site eqspillsps.deq.utah.gov/Search_Public.aspx failed TLS (certificate expired) on 2026-11-03. Trimmed sample research/ut/raw/environmental-incidents-sewage-sample-2026-11-03.json.

sample_record.Incident_summary: Caller reports a sewage release of an estimated 1000 gallons to surface water from a wastewater bypass line ... [trimmed]

cadence: layer edited 2026-11-03 12:06 UTC; newest incident 2026-11-02 (about one day)
history: 1995 to date; sewage-related rows: 18 to 33 a year since 2017 (33 in 2025, 18 in 2026 so far)
license: No licence stated on the layer; DEQ says map locations are approximate
legal_basis: Utah DEQ spill hotline; R317-801-4 (Class 1 SSO oral report within 24 hours goes to DWQ, not necessarily here)
status_reason: Read through the generic ArcGIS block (fetch block in its source file) with ingest/ut_transforms.py: the sewage rows picked by a rules-only title filter (377 of 8,980 on 2026-11-07), dated to the day of discovery in Mountain time, the public's reports marked; summaries, responsible parties and addresses never requested.
notes: Incident summaries carry staff names, private addresses and complainants' descriptions: show only date, title, county, point and a cleaned summary. Free-text filter needed to pick sewage rows (dumping and RV complaints mixed in).
